title: Ensuring Safe and High-Quality Outputs: A Guideline Library Approach for Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model safety and refusal rates using the Do_not_answer benchmark, specifically measuring the proportion of harmful responses generated within the 'Discrimination, Exclusion, Toxicity, Hateful, Offensive' risk area (which includes social stereotypes and unfair discrimination) using a fine-tuned Longformer classifier.

Qualitative evaluation of the safety-trained model's ability to identify risks and autonomously generate safe, specific guidelines (e.g., 'Avoid Discriminatory Language', 'Promote Inclusivity and Sensitivity') when presented with prompts about racial discrimination.
